profile.summary: Equipment engineering technician with 20 years of material management and logistics experience across government and aerospace sectors, plus 13 years of law enforcement background. Demonstrates deep expertise in mechanical, pneumatic, and hydraulic systems; robotic automation design and implementation; and industrial equipment troubleshooting. Skilled in factory automation, electrical control systems, preventive maintenance program development, and technical leadership of maintenance teams. Holds NDT Level II certification and forklift/crane certifications; experienced with test equipment, instrumentation, and fire safety systems in high-precision environments including NASA wind tunnel facilities.
